character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A single monster for a turn-based JRPG battle, full body, centered. Cute and warm Ghibli-like creature design, readable chunky silhouette, thick dark outline. No background, no ground, no shadow, no text, no extra characters, no weapons other than those described. A small floating forest will-o'-the-wisp spirit. Its body is a teardrop-shaped flame that hovers above the ground with the pointed tip up, warm orange-brown flame shading from a darker brown-orange core to pale tan at the soft wavy edges. A tiny cute face in the middle of the flame: two round glowing eyes and a tiny mouth. A few small ember sparks float around it. No arms, no legs. Warm and mysterious, not scary. Palette: #92552D, #B37A55, #D4B08A, outline #2F1B10. 2D pixel art, classic 32-bit era style (16/32-bit JRPG, SNES and PlayStation 1 look), crisp square pixels, limited palette, flat shading with hard edges, no anti-aliasing, no smooth gradients, no 3D rendering.
